- CTA buttons: "Schedule Demo" and "14-Day Starter Trial"
- Uses CSS module classes (div-white-bag, section-high-judge, etc.)

**2. src/components/home/featured-logos.module.css** (129 lines)
- Logo carousel styles with mask-image gradient fade effect
- .logo-3-carousel with left/right fade-to-transparent gradient

- Responsive breakpoints: 767px and 479px
- Column gap 24px desktop, 12px tablet, 30px mobile

**3. src/components/layout/navbar.module.css** (913 lines - first 100 included)
- Comprehensive navbar styling for sticky + responsive navigation
- Banner section (dark blue #082753)
- Logo, nav links, dropdowns with rich card layouts
- Sticky navbar with blur backdrop effect
- Menu toggle animations and mobile responsive changes
- Breakpoints: 1440px, 1280px, 991px, 767px, 479px

**4. src/components/blog/blog-hero.tsx** (56 lines)
- Section with dark blue background (#092245)
- h1: "Insights on Scaling Agencies with White-Label Delivery"
- Subtitle paragraph about practical insights
- 3 stat badges (Built for Agencies, White-Label Expertise, Execution-Focused)
- CTA link: "Explore How It Works"

**5. src/components/blog/blog-hero.module.css** (102 lines)
- Section padding 80px 5% 72px
- Heading uses clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem) for fluid sizing

- Gradient CTA button with hover brightness effect
- Mobile breakpoint 640px

**6. src/components/blog/blog-grid.tsx** (162 lines)
- "use client" component with search + filter functionality
- Filter pills by category (all, …)
- Search input with magnifying glass icon and clear button
- Results count with "Clear filters" option
- 3-column responsive grid of blog cards
- Empty state with icon and "Show all articles" button

**7. src/components/blog/blog-grid.module.css** (249 lines)
- 3-column grid (repeat(3, 1fr))
- Filter buttons with border: 1.5px solid #e5e7eb
- Active filter button: gradient background (#21cfff to #019ae6)
- Search input with focus state box-shadow
- Tablet breakpoint 1024px (2 columns), mobile 640px (1 column)

**8. src/components/testimonials/testimonials-grid.tsx** (20 lines)
- Simple section rendering TESTIMONIALS array
- Maps to TestimonialCard components
- Uses styles from testimonials-grid.module.css

**9. src/components/testimonials/testimonials-grid.module.css** (50 lines)
- Section background #f5f7fa, padding 64px 5% 80px
- 3-column grid with gap 24px, align-items: start
- Tablet 1024px: 2 columns, gap 20px
- Mobile 640px: 1 column, gap 16px

**10. src/components/contact/contact-hero.module.css** (129 lines)
- Section with hero-background-1.png and gradient overlay
- Badge with inline gradient text (text-fill-color transparent)
- h1 font-size 50px, clamps to 36px on tablet, 28px on mobile
- Gradient fade overlay at bottom (120px height)

**11. src/components/contact/contact-form-section.tsx** (257 lines)
- "use client" form component with form validation state
- First Name + Last Name in row
- Email, Phone, Inquiry Type (dropdown), Message fields
- Success message with CheckCircleIcon
- Error message with AlertCircleIcon
- Form submission disabled while submitting

**12. src/components/pricing/roi-calculator.tsx** (first 50 lines)
- "use client" with useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect, useId
- Types: BillingPeriod, PlanKey, CalcState, CalcResult
- PLAN_PRICES object with monthly/quarterly/annual pricing
- Starter ($999-$799), Growth ($1999-$1599), Pro ($3499-$2799)

**13. src/components/our-works/our-works-hero.module.css** (148 lines)
- Dark section (#092245) with hero background and gradient overlay
- Badge with uppercase text-transform
- Main heading with gradient text for accent
- Stats row with white badges (box-shadow)
- Bottom gradient overlay (transparent to #f5f7fa)
- Responsive font reductions at 768px and 479px

**14. src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx** (80+ lines)
- "use client" BetaPopupTrigger component
- Popup overlay modal with left and right panels
- Left panel: exclusive badge, "Private Beta Pricing" heading, check-marked benefits
- Right panel: Founding Partner Pricing (truncated in excerpt)

**15. src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx** (108 lines)
- "use client" email subscription form
- Image icon (sparkle) with "Join 500+ Subscribers"
- "Agency Growth Insights Delivered Monthly" heading
- Email input placeholder "Enter your email"
- Success message: "Thank you! Your submission has been received!"
- Shield icon with privacy message

### WEBFLOW SOURCE FILES (HTML)

**16. boldteq-v1-0.webflow/blog.html** (first 200 lines)
- DOCTYPE with last published date: Sun Apr 12 2026
- Meta: "Agency Growth Blog | White Label Web Dev Insights"
- Navigation structure with Solutions dropdown
- banner-section with "Join Beta" link
- nav-23-container with logo, links, dropdowns
- Icons use SVG gradients (#21CFFF to #019AE6)

**17. boldteq-v1-0.webflow/testimonials.html** (first 200 lines)
- Same header structure and navigation as blog.html
- nav-23-dropdown with Web Development and UI/UX Design options
- "Coming Soon" badge visible in navigation

**18. boldteq-v1-0.webflow/careers.html** (first 150 lines)
- Same structure as other Webflow pages
- body class="body-gradient-image"
- Same navigation, banner, and semantic structure

### KEY OBSERVATIONS FOR AUDIT

**Color Consistency:**
- Primary gradient: #21CFFF to #019AE6 (consistent across all files)
- Dark blue: #092245 (hero sections)
- Secondary dark: #082753 (banner, some text)
- Light background: #f5f7fa

**Typography:**
- Font family: 'Roobert PRO', Arial, sans-serif throughout
- Clamp values used for responsive sizing in several components

**Spacing Patterns:**
- Consistent 5% padding on sections
- Gap patterns: 24px desktop, 20px tablet, 16px mobile (blogs/testimonials)
- Max-width containers: 80rem, 60rem, 56rem depending on section

**Responsive Breakpoints:**
- Desktop: 1440px, 1280px
- Tablet: 1024px, 768px, 767px
- Mobile: 640px, 479px
